display.purpose: Day heading and highest-level screen title.

label.purpose: Times, scores, live minutes and operational metadata.

shadows.name: shell-ambient
shadows.purpose: Separates the framed desktop shell from the outer canvas.

motion.name: control-state
motion.value: background-color 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease
motion.purpose: Quick hover and selection feedback for dense controls.

components.name: Sidebar Active Item
components.description: Active route in the sticky desktop navigation rail.
components.css: .ds-sidebar-item { position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:20px minmax(0,1fr); align-items:center; min-height:41px; padding:0 11px; border-radius:7px; color:#929aa8; background:transparent; font:600 12px/1.2 Inter,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-sidebar-item:hover,.ds-sidebar-item.ds-is-active { background:rgba(34,201,120,.1); color:#eef2fb; } .ds-sidebar-item.ds-is-active::before { position:absolute; top:10px; bottom:10px; left:0; width:2px; border-radius:2px; background:#22c978; content:''; } .ds-sidebar-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #22c978; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Today Filter Chip
components.description: Compact filter used above the Today list.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { min-height:32px; padding:0 9px; border:1px solid rgba(34,201,120,.28); border-radius:6px; background:rgba(34,201,120,.12); color:#a9f3cc; cursor:pointer; font:700 10px/1.2 Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-filter-chip:hover { background:rgba(34,201,120,.18); } .ds-filter-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #22c978; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Featured Match
components.description: Central desktop anchor and second mobile block, populated only from match API data.
components.css: .ds-featured { display:block; width:100%; min-height:326px; padding:18px 20px 20px; border:1px solid rgba(224,232,255,.09); border-radius:10px; background:#151920; color:#f2f5fb; cursor:pointer; } .ds-featured-top { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; padding-bottom:14px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(224,232,255,.09); } .ds-featured-top b { padding:6px 9px; border-radius:5px; background:rgba(34,201,120,.15); color:#a9f3cc; font:700 10px/1.2 Inter,sans-serif; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-featured-top span { color:#8993a2; font:600 11px/1.2 Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-featured-body { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr; align-items:center; gap:16px; min-height:250px; } .ds-featured-body span { display:grid; justify-items:center; gap:9px; } .ds-featured-body i { color:#87909f; font:normal 42px/1 sans-serif; } .ds-featured-body b { font:700 18px/1.05 Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-featured-body strong { font:700 36px/1 'Space Mono',monospace; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-featured:hover { background:linear-gradient(rgba(34,201,120,.075),rgba(34,201,120,.075)),#151920; } .ds-featured:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #22c978; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Live Match Row
components.description: Verified live match row with minute, teams and current score.
components.css: .ds-live-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:42px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items:center; gap:9px; width:100%; min-height:53px; padding:7px 3px; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(224,232,255,.09); background:#151920; color:#f2f5fb; cursor:pointer; text-align:left; } .ds-live-minute { color:#22c978; font:700 10px/1.2 'Space Mono',monospace; } .ds-live-teams { display:grid; gap:4px; } .ds-live-teams b { overflow:hidden; font:700 10px/1.2 Inter,sans-serif; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-live-row strong { font:700 11px/1.2 'Space Mono',monospace; } .ds-live-row:hover { background:rgba(34,201,120,.075); } .ds-live-row:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #22c978; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Schedule Row
components.description: Dense API-backed match row grouped below the first dashboard tier.
components.css: .ds-schedule-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:72px minmax(0,1fr) 58px minmax(0,1fr); align-items:center; gap:12px; width:100%; min-height:45px; padding:7px 10px; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(224,232,255,.09); background:#151920; color:#f2f5fb; cursor:pointer; text-align:left; } .ds-schedule-row time,.ds-schedule-row strong { color:#aeb6c2; font:700 10px/1.2 'Space Mono',monospace; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-schedule-row span { overflow:hidden; font:700 11px/1.2 Inter,sans-serif; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-schedule-row strong { text-align:center; } .ds-schedule-row:hover { background:rgba(34,201,120,.075); } .ds-schedule-row:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #22c978; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Mobile Date Option
components.description: Active date in the mobile-only yesterday/today/tomorrow switcher.
components.css: .ds-date-option { display:grid; min-height:52px; place-content:center; gap:3px; padding:5px 8px; border:1px solid rgba(34,201,120,.48); border-radius:7px; background:rgba(34,201,120,.12); color:#67e6a8; cursor:pointer; font:700 11px/1.2 Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-date-option small { color:#9becbf; font:500 9px/1.2 Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-date-option:hover { background:rgba(34,201,120,.18); } .ds-date-option:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #22c978; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Mobile Bottom Navigation Item
components.description: Active item in the fixed safe-area-aware mobile bottom bar.
components.html: Главная
components.css: .ds-bottom-item { display:grid; min-height:48px; place-items:center; gap:4px; padding:8px; color:#87909f; font:600 10px/1.2 Inter,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-bottom-item svg { width:22px; height:22px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; stroke-width:1.7; } .ds-bottom-item:hover,.ds-bottom-item.ds-is-active { color:#22c978; } .ds-bottom-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #22c978; outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview:
AlmazStat выглядит как компактная операторская игрового дня: матовые графитовые панели, тонкие холодные разделители, плотная спортивная типографика и один уверенный зелёный сигнал. Экран должен ощущаться рабочим, быстрым и фактическим — без рекламной театральности и декоративной «аналитики».

Иерархия строится композицией и плотностью. На desktop три главные зоны видны одновременно, а устойчивый левый sidebar держит контекст навигации. На mobile оболочка исчезает, дата становится явным контролом, а порядок контента следует срочности: LIVE, главный матч, матчи сегодня, затем расписание.
keyCharacteristics: Графитовая низкобликовая основа с холодными тонкими границами.
Единственный primary — яркий зелёный; gold и indigo не используются.
Плотные панели и компактные строки вместо больших декоративных карточек.
Inter для интерфейса и Space Mono для времени, счёта и live-статуса.
Только реальные API-данные и честные empty/loading/error-состояния.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Primary green is the only accent: do not revive gold or indigo for branding, priority, selection, or focus.

rules.name: The Verified Live Rule
rules.body: Green may label LIVE only when the API status belongs to the verified live-status set; otherwise show a factual empty or upcoming state.

rules.name: The Numeric Instrument Rule
rules.body: Use Space Mono with tabular numerals for kickoff times, scores and live minutes; team names and prose remain in Inter.

rules.name: The Recomposition Rule
rules.body: At 800px, change navigation and semantic order; do not merely shrink the desktop columns.

rules.name: The First-Row Contract Rule
rules.body: Desktop always presents Today matches / Featured / LIVE as peer operational zones, with schedule as the next tier.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: Information hierarchy comes from grid placement, tonal surfaces and typography; dashboard panels do not float independently.

dos: Do use the approved graphite sports control room composition and Signal Green as the sole primary accent.
Do keep desktop order as Today matches / Featured / LIVE, with schedule below.
Do keep mobile order as LIVE / Featured / Today, with the date switcher above and fixed bottom navigation below.
Do render teams, leagues, logos, times, statuses and scores only from the API, preserving honest loading, empty and error states.
Do make score, time and live status scannable with Space Mono and tabular numerals.
donts: Don't reintroduce gold, indigo, purple gradients or their glow treatments.
Don't use the old two-column featured/next layout for the dashboard's first tier.
Don't show fake standings, team-of-the-week modules, invented metrics, editorial headlines, photos, predictions or simulated live activity.
Don't keep the desktop sidebar visible on mobile or replace the fixed mobile bottom navigation with desktop controls.
Don't flatten the page into equal repeated cards; preserve the distinct roles of LIVE, Featured, Today and Schedule.
